title: The Tide Pool Eye
youtube_title: The Tide Pool Eye | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Ximena finds a tide pool no bigger than a plate, with one shrimp. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Ximena shows Orla how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
